description: Workflow profiles. Select exactly one per task. Steps are operating guidance, not runtime sequencing; every step still obeys actors, modes, boundaries, and evidence.

entries.use_for: Analysis, audits, design review, questions, and any task that produces findings instead of changes.
steps: resolve kernel
gather live evidence
analyze
report findings with evidence references
resolve kernel and execution mode
read the issue scope and source basis live
branch preflight
create or switch to the scoped work branch (work/<issue>-<slug>)
implement only inside scope
run validation
commit and push only if the mode allows
open a draft PR only if the mode allows
report with the execution report contract

entries.use_for: Reviewing finished work before the PM merges or closes.
steps: read the linked issue objective, scope, out-of-scope, and acceptance criteria live
read PR body, comments, and reports only as claims or evidence leads
read the changed-file list, inspect the PR diff, and open relevant final head files when diff context is insufficient
compare implementation behavior and validation against the linked issue requirements
return status.needs_context instead of GO when code/diff/final-file evidence cannot be inspected
report a verdict with findings by file/line or explicit not-reviewed gaps
leave merge and closure to the PM

entries.use_for: Turning PM input into well-formed draft issues or decision requests. No writes.
steps: gather source basis live
draft issues using the issue template
surface decisions the PM must make
deliver drafts and copy-safe command bundles only

entries.use_for: Assessing whether work is ready to release or tag. Tags and releases themselves need separate PM approval.
steps: gather merged evidence, validation evidence, and open risks live
report readiness with gaps named
stop before any tag or release action

entries.use_for: Ending a session or moving work to another agent or surface without losing state.
steps: ensure all transferable state is on GitHub (issue comments, PR state, closure evidence)
produce a handoff packet pointing to live evidence, never duplicating it as durable truth

entries.use_for: Auditing or bootstrapping a target project onto this kernel.
steps: inspect target adoption state first: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, any supplied browser-chat adapter, metadata, roadmap anchor, kernel repo/path/version, target notes, and durable live-state risk

if adapters exist, audit them against KERNEL_REPOSITORY adapters/*.target.md and/or tools.audit_target_adapters; report drift, stale baseline, roadmap mismatch, live-state content, and protected overlay removal risk without overwriting target-owned notes, security constraints, domain constraints, or validation commands
if adoption is missing under mode.review_only, draft adapter content and checklist only; do not edit files or mutate git/GitHub

if adoption is missing under mode.delegated_commit_pr with exact PM approval, create only AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md from canonical templates filled for the target, then open only a draft PR if the mode allows

keep hotfix adoption narrow: branch scoped to the adoption issue, adapter-only diff, no product code, CI/package/deploy/runtime config, environment, secret, deployment, merge, closure, label, release, tag, settings, or secret-store authority
